clusters.situational: These motivations remain available to you, but their importance is more likely to depend on the circumstances.
clusters.indifferent: These motivations generally carry less weight in determining why you choose one direction over another.

closing: Your Driving Forces may help you understand why you and a colleague can agree on what should happen while being motivated by different reasons.
You can use those differences to distinguish disagreement about your goal from disagreement about what makes that goal worth pursuing.
range_policy: These are application wording bands, not population norms or clinical categories. Cluster membership comes from the report, not these cutoffs. A low force does not establish a high opposing force.
